        You need to extract all code statements that lead to the bug from the patch, based on the root cause and the commit message.

        Root cause:
        The bug was caused by the incorrect handling of the condition flags for the ARM instructions `OP_mov` and `OP_lsl`, which were incorrectly marked as affecting the flags when they do not. This led to potential misinterpretation of the instruction behavior during disassembly and execution.
        
        Commit message:
        i#1686 decoder tests: OP_mov and OP_lsl do not touch flags

Fixes a bug from 4d8bc7cf2f799ffe0434f9fa59186efe988b5400: OP_mov and
OP_lsl do not touch the condition flags.

Also fixes a release-build compiler warning with recent gcc versions.

Review-URL: https://codereview.appspot.com/229330043

             /* {op/type, op encoding, name, dst1, dst2, src1, src2, src3, flags, eflags, code} */

-      {OP_mov,   0x0000, "mov",        RZw, xx, RYw,   xx, xx, no, fWNZCV, z96[1][0x08]},
